from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityData(BaseModel):
    """Raw metrics for a single university extracted from its Common Data Set report."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(..., description="The name of the university as reported")
    total_undergraduates: int | None = Field(..., description="Total number of degree-seeking undergraduate students")
    hispanic_latino_count: int | None = Field(..., description="Number of Hispanic/Latino undergraduate students")
    asian_count: int | None = Field(..., description="Number of Asian, non-Hispanic undergraduate students")
    total_applicants: int | None = Field(..., description="Total number of first-time, first-year degree-seeking applicants")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    universities: list[UniversityData]
